8.3.1.3 E2E_P01Forward
[SWS_E2E_00588] Definition of API function E2E_P01Forward
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: RS_E2E_08527, RS_E2E_08528
⌈
Service Name
E2E_P01Forward (draft)
Syntax
Std_ReturnType E2E_P01Forward (
const E2E_P01ConfigType* ConfigPtr,
E2E_PCheckStatusType Checkstatus,
E2E_P01ProtectStateType* StatePtr,
uint8* DataPtr
)
Service ID [hex]
0x38
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
ConfigPtr
Pointer to static configuration.
Parameters (in)
Checkstatus
E2E Status of the received message
StatePtr
Pointer to port/data communication state.
Parameters (inout)
DataPtr
Pointer to Data to be transmitted.
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E2E_E_INPUTERR_NULL
E2E_E_INPUTERR_WRONG
E2E_E_INTERR
E2E_E_OK
For definitions for return values, see SWS_E2E_00047.
Description
Protects data which is forwarded by using the E2E profile 01. This includes checksum
calculation, handling of counter and Data ID. Detected Errors of received message will be
reconstruct on output data.
